introduction: Born in Thomasville, Georgia, John Jamieson Michaels, known as JJ to his friends and family, was raised with Southern roots, strong faith, and a deep love for sport and the outdoors. A natural athlete and competitor, he grew up playing football, baseball, and tennis - disciplines that shaped his work ethic, resilience, and drive.After moving to Miami to pursue modeling, John transitioned to Los Angeles, where the acting bug took hold. What began as a career shift quickly became a calling. Since then, he has led multiple vertical series and continues to train rigorously, refining his craft with discipline and intention.But acting is only part of his legacy Mission To be a living contribution to Heaven on Earth. Not a distant religious ideal - but the highest sustainable reality humans can create together: clean, toxin-free, vibrant, and aligned. Vision Clean air. Clean water. Clean soil. For all humankind.10-Year Vision . Become the male Gwyneth Paltrow (minus the witch stuff) - merging culture and clean living. . The Matthew McConaughey of holistic health - grounded, charismatic, and rooted in purpose. . With the strategic investment instincts of Ashton Kutcher, The Rock, and Ryan Reynolds. . Book Chanel and Armani fragrance campaigns. . Build and invest in brands that elevate human health and consciousness.Beyond the Camera John is passionate about: . Holistic health . Organic nutrition . Gut health optimization . Nontoxic skincare & clean beauty . Biohacking . Long-distance running . Rock climbing . Sunshine therapy . Time outdoors with his puppy, Happy Noodle He believes the body is an instrument - and stewardship of that instrument is non-negotiable.Dream RoleTo portray King David in a major motion picture - exploring the complexity, faith, strength, and humanity of one of history’s most compelling leaders.- IMDb mini biography by: Cindy Sorley - Manager
